analysis_result.analysis: The model failed by misperceiving the visual structure of the orange rope as two distinct lines, leading to an inflated count of 6 instead of the correct 5. This is a perceptual error rooted in misidentifying a single continuous line as multiple entities, not a logical or mathematical mistake. The rest of the model’s reasoning was internally consistent — it correctly identified the other four ropes (white, red, yellow, purple) — but the hallucination of an extra orange line corrupted the final tally. The error is major because it directly contradicts the observable visual fact that only five ropes were generated and drawn.
